text:
kevin: Heads-up: planned midnight wave for runtime/api/console/router. Need final pins and rollback gates. Target window 00:30-02:00 UTC. Can runtime and router confirm interop with header-split toggle? @maria @jonathan @lina

maria: runtime tested against header-split off — KV eviction behavior looks normal. Will hold runtime binary at v2.49.0 for this wave.

jonathan: API v1.68.2 is ready. Backwards compatible with router header-split off. Need to confirm schema toggle in console.

lina: console will flip feature flag 'header_split_preview' to false for release; will pin UI build to 2026.03.15. Putting release notes snippet in the docs repo. Also: can someone add a fallback route in router to default to old header headerX if new fails?

kevin: yes, plan: router will ship v3.11.0 but keep header_split disabled by default. If latency > 250ms p50 or error rate > 0.5% for 10m, we rollback router and runtime. Rollback order: router -> runtime -> api -> console. We should also disable canary traffic to dedicated pool on rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: wave 1 (5%), wave 2 (25%), wave 3 (100%). Target groups: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Command: /deploy release v2.3.1 --staged --pins runtime=v2.49.0 api=v1.68.2 console=2026.03.15 router=v3.11.0

maria: Adding KV cache warmup in wave 1: pre-populate prefixes for top-100 endpoints to avoid cold misses. config snippet:
```
cache.preload: true
cache.preload.endpoints: ['/generate', '/chat']
```

sre-bot: sre-bot: Alert rule check passed. Dashboards shipped. Adding a 15-minute quiet window buffer before traffic step increases.

jonathan: Can we hold wave 2 until router p50 < 200ms for 20m? If so, we gate. Also confirm rollout notes: 'API: stable minor bump; no breaking changes.'

lina: Confirmed. console will open a canary channel for internal QA via feature flag. Release notes draft:
- runtime: v2.49.0 (stability and KV warmup)
- router: v3.11.0 (header-split behind flag)
- api: v1.68.2 (minor fixes)
- console: pinned UI 2026.03.15

kevin: Rollback trigger and steps added to release doc. Quick sanity: @deploy-bot please run dry-run for wave plan and post summary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Dry-run OK. Estimated 60s per shard pod rolling, expected full rollout ~45m with quiet window. Posting summary link: https://rwd.intern/releases/6123456789-dryrun-summary

sre-bot: sre-bot: I'll watch latency, error_rate, and 5xx counts. On rollback we'll mute alerting escalation and open incident channel #release-6123456789.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll stay on-call for runtime during the window.

jonathan: I'll monitor API errors and schema mismatches.

lina: I'll coordinate release notes publish and post to #product after first green wave.

kevin: OK launching at 00:30 UTC. Everyone on pager for +30m after full rollout. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave 1 (5%) -> SUCCESS
Wave 2 (25%) -> HOLD (router p50 = 268ms)
Pausing increment per gate.

maria: seeing increased redis misses in EU shard. Rolling back header_split config to off for router in eu-west-1. Command: /router toggle header_split eu-west-1 off

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router toggle applied in eu-west-1. Rolling wave back to 5% in eu-west-1 only.

sre-bot: sre-bot: Alert: router p50 spike cleared in 6m after toggle. No 5xx increase. Recommend resume to 25% in 20m if stable.

kevin: Good catch. Continue with warming and then resume. Keep rollback criteria as defined. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave 2 resumed -> SUCCESS
Wave 3 (100%) -> SUCCESS
Release v2.3.1 complete. Opening postmortem thread if any regressions.

maria: runtime telemetry looks healthy, KV hit rate +12% after preload.

jonathan: API steady. No downstream schema failures.

lina: Release notes posted: https://rwd.intern/releases/v2.3.1-notes
I'll close internal QA channel at 01:45 UTC.

kevin: Closing thread: all services rolled, monitoring 30m. Thanks all. :tada:
